title: Chronon Performance Baseline — official benchmark manifest
notes: Each BENCH-N maps to a canonical Composition registered in bench/corpus/bench_corpus_scenes.cpp (TICKET-BENCH-CORPUS-V1 conventions).
BENCH-4 reuses the EXISTING BenchB06_VideoOverlay1080p factory (video + overlays + text) — no duplicate composition (Cat-3 anti-dup).
Saturation JSON is produced by `chronon3d_cli benchmark --scene <id> --saturation --report-json [--backend auto|software|vulkan]`.
Encode fps is read from the video-export .timing.json sidecar (end_to_end_fps / render_only_fps).
Regression budgets are LOCKED from the first honest machine-verified run with +40% frame-time headroom; every future change compares against them (PASS/FAIL).

GPU-side budgets (gpu_execute_us, gpu_readback_bytes) are filled when the GPU path is measurable on the machine; on CPU-only hosts they remain null (gate skips them with an explicit INFO, never masking a FAIL).

benchmarks.name: Motion Graphics
benchmarks.content: shapes + transforms + glow (blur excluded in v1 — software-backend composite SEGV, see TICKET-PERF-BASELINE-V1)

benchmarks.name: VideoOverlayDynamic
benchmarks.content: dynamic video stream + overlays + text (YUV certification)

host_policy.note: The runner records tools/benchmark_host_info.sh attributes; budgets are only comparable on the same machine class.
